correctness.rationale: The smooth 81-fold tame cover has genus 55. Character vectors up to sign yield 10 genus-zero, 10 supersingular elliptic, 15 ordinary genus-two, and 5 genus-three quotient factors with prime-to-2 isogeny, so their 2-divisible invariants add. Hidalgo computes genus-ten type (3,3) p-rank 6, forcing each associated genus-two quotient to be ordinary. For the genus-three cyclic quotient y^3=f(t), the explicit Cartier images yield a=1 and stable rank 2 exactly when cubic coefficient s1 is nonzero. The five Möbius transforms yield the five asserted equations and elimination gives only the two fivefold points and all distinct tangents. Exact script replay corroborates the critical finite identities.
